'''Megalox Beta''' was a [[planet]] in the [[Expansion Region]] that housed a [[prison]] known as [[Megalox]] which [[Poe Dameron]] and [[Black Squadron (Resistance)|Black Squadron]] [[Mission to Megalox Beta|visited]] during their [[Hunt for Lor San Tekka|search]] for [[Lor San Tekka]]. The planet had a high [[gravity]] and was considered inhospitable, except for a small gravity field-covered zone that housed the Megalox prison. The planet was the site of a brief skirmish between the [[Resistance]] and the [[First Order]].

==Description==
[[File:GravityBeltsBenefit-PoeDameron6.png|thumb|left|250px|Megalox Beta had a gravitational pull ten times greater than standard]]
Due to its enormous size and high density, Megalox Beta generated a [[Gravity|gravitational]] pull ten times standard. Outside an artificial standard grav-field dome, anyone walking on the surface of the planet would be instantly crushed under ten times their own weight. The only settlement on the planet was a prison called [[Megalox]], which was protected by a gravity shield generated by an orbiting [[Megalox space station|space station]]. Megalox was home to some of the worst criminals in [[the galaxy]]. One known location inside the prison was [[Fortress of Grakkus the Hutt|Grakkus' fortress]].<ref name="Poe Dameron 4" />

==History==
By [[34 ABY]], Megalox Beta was regarded as a dumping ground for some of the worst criminals in the galaxy including [[Grakkus Jahibakti Tingi|Grakkus]] the [[Hutt]],<ref name="Poe Dameron 4" /> [[Kan Be]], [[Toren|Papa Toren]], and [[Isin]].<ref name="Poe Dameron 5">[[Poe Dameron 5|''Poe Dameron'' 5]]</ref> These criminals dwelled in a settlement that was protected by a gravity field. The prisoners were left to govern themselves, subsisting on supplies ferried from the orbiting space station. The prison was administrated by [[Warden]] [[Luta]], who could be bribed into admitting visitors.<ref name="Poe Dameron 4" />

Following the [[Mission to Ovanis]], [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] of the [[Resistance]] managed to bribe Warden Luta into allowing [[Poe Dameron]] and his [[Black Squadron (Resistance)|Black Squadron]] to question Grakkus for information about the explorer [[Lor San Tekka]]. However, the [[First Order]] [[Agent]] [[Terex]] outbidded Leia with a larger bribe to ensure that the guards abandoned Black Squadron to the prisoners instead of escorting them directly to Grakkus' fortress. In a bid to escape, Grakkus offered to sell the information to whoever could free him from Megalox.<ref name="Poe Dameron 4" />

[[File:BrawlOnMegaloxBeta-PoeDameron6.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Black Squadron's presence incited a riot on Megalox Beta]]
Incensed at Grakkus for breaking their deal, Terex hired Kan Be, Toren, and Isin to rally their gangs for an assault on Grakkus' fortress. In response, Poe got his droid [[BB-8]] and the squadron's other [[astromech droid]]s to disable the station's gravity field generator.<ref name="Poe Dameron 5" /> The prisoners were overwhelmed by Megalox Beta's high gravity. After disabling the gravity shield, Black Squadron was able to convince Warden Luta to let them escape with Grakkus. Before the prison authorities could restore the gravity field, Terex disabled the space station with his starship ''[[Carrion Spike]]''. Black Squadron then turned around and attacked Terex's ship, allowing the prison authorities to safely evacuate the prisoners.<ref name="Poe Dameron 6" />

==Behind the scenes==
Megalox Beta first appeared in the [[2016]] [[Marvel Comics|comic]] [[Poe Dameron 4|''Poe Dameron'' 4]], written by [[Charles Soule]] and illustrated by [[Phil Noto]].
